question: Where should the self be placed?
premises: The self is the object to be placed.
The place is the hollow of the skanda-kūṭa seed.
inference: The practitioner places the self in that hollow.
uncertainties: The exact ritual referent of skanda-kūṭa seed is not glossed.
plain_english: One should place the self in the hollow of the skanda-kūṭa seed.
